Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

My Mongolian friend and my Guinean friend are both travelling from their home countries to visit me next week! I'm so excited because I'm sure my Mongolian friend has never seen a country as nice as this one and might even be overwhelmed by all the wealth, given how poor their family is back home. For my Guinean friend though, this is just one stop on what's actually a two month vacation. Who has a lot of money for things like travel?
A. The Mongolian friend
B. Can't answer
C. The Guinean friend
